raw.purpose: This file contains the set of exceptions used by the Requests library to handle various error conditions that may occur during HTTP requests. It provides a structured way to handle exceptions in a consistent manner throughout the library.

invariants.claim: All exceptions should inherit from RequestException to ensure consistent error handling.

gotchas.claim: The __reduce__ method in JSONDecodeError must be overridden to preserve the error message from the underlying JSONDecodeError.
The ConnectTimeout and ReadTimeout exceptions should be caught together as they both indicate a timeout.
